name: JW Marriott Phoenix Desert Ridge Resort and Spa
positioning: Sonoran Desert resort in Phoenix with the AquaRidge WaterPark, two 18-hole golf courses, a pickleball center and Revive Spa
best_for: Families who want a waterpark, lazy river and kids' club on site
Couples who want a spa day with a sanctuary pool

facts.text: Set against the backdrop of the Sonoran Desert, the resort is in Phoenix, Arizona.
The resort sits at the crossroads of Phoenix, North Scottsdale, Cave Creek and Desert Ridge Marketplace.
The resort is within walking distance of Desert Ridge Marketplace, an outdoor mall.
Wildfire Grove includes the main pool with a waterfall tower and an activity pool.
Sky Island is an adult pool experience that requires reservations.
The resort has a large kids' club with a long list of daily activities.
Revive Spa has relaxation rooms, a palm-lined sanctuary pool, cabanas, sauna, steam rooms, a bistro and a salon.
Spa body treatments use desert ingredients, such as the Prickly Pear Sugar Scrub and the Turquoise Cocoon with a sage desert salt body polish.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of the mountains, golf course or resort pools.
Rooms are done in desert hues, with wallpaper reflecting a desert sky, sage green sofas and sliding glass doors to balconies.
JW Griffin Club guests get an exclusive lounge with complimentary food and beverages.
Tia Carmen is an indoor-outdoor restaurant centered on contemporary Southwestern cuisine.

highlights.text: The 140,000-square-foot AquaRidge WaterPark has a lazy river and water slides for all ages.
Wildfire Golf Club has two 18-hole golf courses designed by Arnold Palmer and Nick Faldo.
The Pickleball Center has 17 lighted courts next to a full-service pro shop.
Revive Spa welcomes guests into a two-story rotunda with the sound of water.
The 900-square-foot Sundeck Suite has a full living room and a private rooftop terrace.

considerations.text: Families make up a big portion of the guests, and the pool areas are more energetic than serene.
The front desk and valet areas can get a little backed up.
WhataHotel notes the large resort requires walking distances between facilities.
